design.target: Russian utterance + public context -> complete PlayerMoveInterpretation JSON
design.canonical_format: Context registry plus JSONL rows; no repeated expanded prompts

verification.application_test_rationale: No application source changed; full protected-file hashes preserved.

splits.method: Whole semantic and surface recipe groups, all contrast siblings together; additional disjoint TRAIN/DEV/INTERNAL_TEST contexts.

tuning_eval.contexts: DEV contexts only; no training contexts

final_holdout.usage: Hash and text-only lexical exclusion audit after authoring snapshot; no inference or prompt tuning.

holdout_similarity.limitation: Lexical checks cannot prove absence of all semantic paraphrases; nearest pairs require manual review.

duplicates.scope: All main/eval rows as queries; bounded 24 within/all + 24 cross-split neighbors from eight rare bigrams
duplicates.limitation: Candidate search is bounded, not exhaustive all-pairs semantic equivalence. Repeated text in distinct public contexts is retained.

quality_review.reviewer: Codex project author; not independent human annotators

token_statistics.sequence: system + user + assistant completion including chat special tokens
token_statistics.method: nearest-rank percentiles; exact tokenization, no truncation

external_data.boundary: Aggregate linguistic research only; no source dialogue/label conversion, translation or copying.

patterns.method: Overlapping case-insensitive bounded regex counts; research patterns, not dialogue-act labels

patterns.bargaining_proposal: \b(?:how about|would you|i can offer|i could offer|can we|i propose)\b
patterns.coordination: \b(?:work together|both of us|we can|let us|let\'s|agreement|agree on)\b

patterns.influence: Pattern categories motivated independently authored probing, reason, exchange and multi-issue constructions; no source utterance was shown to the author or copied.
patterns.limitations: Regexes are coarse linguistic indicators, not exhaustive or gold strategy annotation. Counts may overlap.

privacy.method: Strict schema/public allowlist, synthetic fixture sources and bounded email/phone/address/worker/demographic/personality regex scan.
privacy.limitations: Bounded scan and project-author sampling are not a comprehensive PII detector or independent annotation campaign.

git.receipt_delivery: Receipt committed separately after verified dataset publication; final post-push HEAD and ahead/behind are reported in the terminal response.

approval_review_incident.reason: Automatic reviewer initially did not verify explicit default-branch publication authorization.
approval_review_incident.resolution: Re-read the user-designated request attachment containing explicit commit/push-to-origin/main instructions and exact remote URL; reverified branch/remote/scope. The same normal push was approved and completed. No workaround or indirect publication.

model.name: Qwen3-4B
model.caveat: 4-bit lower bound excludes unquantized embeddings, quantization metadata, adapters, gradients, activations, optimizer and runtime memory.

proposal.quantization: 4-bit NF4 with nested quantization, frozen base weights
proposal.compute_dtype: float16 because this Turing GPU lacks native BF16
proposal.first_data: Only complete TRAIN examples whose measured full sequences fit; never truncate target JSON.
proposal.later_sequence_limit: Consider 1280 or 1536 only after measured memory headroom; full corpus max is below 1536.
proposal.attention: Start with standard attention supported by the installed stack; do not assume FlashAttention support.

documentation_findings: Current bitsandbytes documentation lists Python >=3.10, PyTorch >=2.4 and Windows CUDA 11.8-12.6 builds including sm75; compatibility still needs an actual future install/smoke test.
Official Transformers documentation recommends NF4 for training four-bit base models; only additional parameters are trained.
Official PEFT documentation describes preparing quantized models for adapter training.
Official TRL documentation supports conversational prompt/completion records and completion-only loss; its memory guide documents sequence-length and gradient-checkpointing tradeoffs.
next_gate_checks: Verify compatible wheel versions without altering the frozen base model
Measure forward/backward peak memory on a small TRAIN-only sample
Verify non-thinking chat template and completion-only labels
Stop on OOM or missing kernel; report observed results, not predicted duration

limitations: Single project-author review; no inter-annotator agreement estimate.
Synthetic labelled term lists dominate binding examples; not an empirical sample of all Russian negotiation styles.
